title: The Warm Stone in the Stream

collection.credit: NEW EVENTS — LUCK, OMENS AND LAVASTONES (LO-01 to LO-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager wading in the stream finds a warm, glowing stone: a lavastone.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Wading in the stream, (name1)'s foot touches something warm. (He/She) reaches down and pulls out a stone about the size of an egg. It's smooth, a deep reddish-orange, and slightly see-through, like honey. In the shade, there's a faint glow deep inside it. It's warm, like something alive. (name1) has heard stories about stones like this. Lavastones.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The elders gather round. One says it's a gift from the island itself. One says it's a spirit sleeping in stone. One says it's just a rare kind of rock, and the glow is only the light. They argue about it gently for some time. Nobody agrees. In the end they decide (name1) found it, so (name1) should decide. (name1) puts it on a shelf in (his/her) hut, where it glows softly at night like a tiny ember.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (name1) holds it for a long moment, feeling the warmth seep into (his/her) hand. Then (he/she) puts it back in the stream exactly where (he/she) found it. Some things, (he/she) thinks, aren't meant to be taken home. For weeks afterward, the water in that part of the stream feels just a little bit warmer.
